name: proto-import-outside-the-import-roots
description: Only the import roots proto.import_paths names are searched: an import of a schema file outside them is unresolved, so the declaration whose type it would supply is published live with an unresolved-import note on the importing file, and the file outside them is still published under its path from the target root. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
